reviewFindings: No repeated minute-by-minute restart loops remain in the 150-resident, 72-hour run.
Sampled infants received care without performing adult social actions; nearby conversations appear only as observations.
Sampled children and teens attended learning activities and kept strict romantic need age caps.
Working adults completed work blocks, traveled, paused for bodily needs and resumed retained progress.
Older adults pursued hobbies and social contact; individual activity and interaction frequencies differed.
Three of fourteen sampled Sims briefly had a critical physical need at one hourly observation; none had persistent sampled critical hunger, thirst, bladder or fatigue.
The audit is a representative deterministic test. It cannot certify every future world, personality combination or long-term outcome.
